## Introduction

In this post, I will explore the Palmer Penguins dataset using Python. I will use pandas to examine the data, compare different penguin species, and create visualizations with matplotlib.

My goal is to understand how average body mass differs across penguin species.



## Loading the Data

I will first load the Palmer Penguins dataset and look at the first five rows.

```{python}
#| warning: false

from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

penguins = load_penguins()
penguins.head()
```

Data source: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/), Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.




## Number of Penguins

I will count how many penguins belong to each species.

```{python}
penguins["species"].value_counts()
```



## Comparing Species

I will calculate the average body mass for each penguin species.

```{python}
average_mass = penguins.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].mean()
average_mass
```




## Visualization

I will use a bar chart to compare the average body mass of each species.

```{python}
#| label: fig-penguin-mass
#| fig-cap: "Average body mass by penguin species."

average_mass.plot(kind="bar")
plt.ylabel("Average Body Mass (g)")
plt.xlabel("Species")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```



## Conclusion

The chart shows that Gentoo penguins have the highest average body mass among the three species. This simple analysis demonstrates how Python can be used to summarize and visualize data.
